artworks.title: Odysseus Recognized by His Dog Argus
artworks.description: From the print series The Works of Odysseus: the beggar bends to the old hound on the dung-heap — the one recognition on Ithaca that needs no scar and no test.

films.title: Ulysses
films.description: Kirk Douglas enters his hall as a beggar — Eumaeus' hut, the scar, and the suitors' insults before the bow.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: The miniseries dwells on the disguised king — Athena's beggar, Eurycleia's recognition, and Penelope's test.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.description: Books XIII–XIX — the swineherd's hut, the hall of mockery, and the king who waits to string his own bow.

popCulture.title: Eumaeus
popCulture.description: The loyal swineherd remains the Odyssey's emblem of hospitality kept when the house itself is violated.
